easyPrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and then Thermopod, adding {R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
